title: Duterte defense again opposes bid to admit witness testimony

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte’s defense counsel before the International Criminal Court (ICC) objected to the prosecution’s request to admit as evidence the recorded testimony of another witness. The objection stems from the prosecution’s previous application to have the court accept the pre-recorded testimonies of witnesses “P-0024,” “P-1357,” and “P-1359,” along with their associated materials without them testifying before the court to expedite the case. According to the prosecution, the testimonies of these three witnesses hold key information on “Oplan Tokhang” and extrajudicial killings during Duterte’s presidency.
